value.name: Mrs. Adelman confirms lawyer took document
value.description: Mrs. Adelman explains that the lawyer took the document, filed it in a blue folder, and she did not watch him leave.
evidence: "And the lawyer took the document with him."
"He put it in a file. A blue folder. I assume he took it. I didn't watch him leave."

value.name: Mrs. Adelman expresses loyalty to Helena
value.description: Mrs. Adelman thanks Asha and says Helena was good to her, hoping the matter will come out right.
evidence: "Helena was good to me," Mrs. Adelman said. "I would like this to come out right."

value.name: Asha requests physical archive search
value.description: Asha calls the successor firm again and asks them to check the physical archive for a blue folder with Helena Serrano's name and a September twelfth date.
evidence: Asha set down the phone and sat for a long moment with her hand still on it.

Then she called the successor firm again and asked, in the politest possible voice, whether someone could check the physical archive, not just the digital one, for a blue folder bearing Helena Serrano's name and a date of September twelfth.

value.name: Receptionist promises callback
value.description: The receptionist tells Asha she will have to call back later after checking the archive request.
evidence: "I'll have to call you back," the receptionist said.

value.name: Lucia contacts Asha secretly
value.description: Lucia calls Asha using Rosa's help to get her direct line and says she needs to speak without Daniel present.
evidence: "Rosa gave it to me," Lucia said. "I hope that's all right. I needed to talk to you without Daniel in the house."

value.name: Lucia says Daniel is meeting agent secretly
value.description: Lucia tells Asha that Daniel has gone to meet with an agent, despite claiming he is not meeting with one.
evidence: "He's gone to meet with the agent. The one he says he's not meeting with."

value.name: Lucia reveals hidden letter
value.description: Lucia tells Asha she found a handwritten letter in the sewing room that was addressed to her and appears to be from her mother.
evidence: "There's a letter," Lucia said. "I found it in the sewing room three days ago, before you came. It was in the drawer of the side table where Mom kept her thimbles. It's in her handwriting. It is addressed to me."

value.name: Lucia reports changed will
value.description: Lucia begins reading the letter, which says her mother changed her will and wanted Lucia to know directly in case the paperwork was lost.
evidence: "It says she has changed her will. It says she wanted me to know directly, in case anything happened to the paperwork."

value.name: Lucia begins revealing letter's trust statement
value.description: Lucia starts to say that the letter states her mother trusts someone, but the message cuts off before the full statement is revealed.
